# Application Assessment Setup

This Java project requires the following MCP tools to run AppCAT assessment:

- `appmod-precheck-assessment`
- `appmod-run-assessment`

## Setup Instructions

1. Configure the AppCAT MCP server tools (`appmod-precheck-assessment` and `appmod-run-assessment`) in your environment.
2. Re-run the assessment skill once the MCP tools are available.
3. The assessment report will be generated at `.github/modernize/appcat/report.json`.
